sourcePrompts.label: A / soft sculpt
sourcePrompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: professional character art-direction exploration for Nunti, a journey-born collectible companion. Create a landscape character concept plate of THREE entirely original, irresistibly cute, emotionally engaging collectible characters. Each is a NEW being born from one travel experience, with substantially different body silhouette and morphology, not the same mascot wearing different outfits. The three journeys in order: a coastal-town relaxation trip, a mountain camping trip, an urban art-museum day. Express the journey through the character's body and material design. Highest priority: refined art direction, memorable silhouette, endearing proportions, tactile collectibility, sensitive face design, the urge to keep this tiny companion. They are calm cheerful companions, not punishments or guilt devices. 2.5D illustration with convincing sculpted depth, soft studio lighting, restrained tactile details, clean edges suitable for later layered animation. Show whole bodies in a frontal three-quarter view at matching scale, large and clearly separated, subtle grounding shadows on warm ivory. Three approximately equal columns, generous blank margins, no scene background, no frame, no UI, no writing, no logo, no watermark. One cohesive world and studio lighting per plate. Distinct anatomy and expressions per character. Do not resemble existing franchise characters. Do not add clothes as the main differentiation. Tiny hands/feet, expressive eyes and tiny mouths, facial details readable at small sizes. Avoid uncanny humanoid eyes, excessive glossy eyeballs, angry faces, baby-product clipart, generic stock mascots, overdecorated accessories. ART DIRECTION A: soft sculptural pocket spirits, velvety matte clay, a little peach-fuzz softness, warm diffuse subsurface depth, sophisticated pastel gradients. Premium small sculpture, tender asymmetry, no visible fur strands. Coastal character: a low round sea-foam creature with folded wave-shaped ears, curved little tail, sea-glass mint and warm cream, inquisitive lively face. Mountain character: squat pear-shaped moss-and-seed creature with two sprouting leaf ears, toasted cream and muted sage, sturdy tiny feet, calm sleepy confidence. Museum character: a small apricot cushion-shaped celestial creature with two uneven curved antenna-like horns, gentle powder-blue accents, shy curious smile, one tiny sculpted star marking. Make all three feel as lovable as a cherished hand-sized keepsake. Their silhouettes must clearly differ, with beautiful simple forms rather than busy details.

refinements.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a new refined Nunti collectible companion character design plate using Image 1 (plush direction B) for tactile softness, refined warm studio lighting, and emotional warmth, and Image 2 (soft-sculpt direction A) for stronger anatomical silhouette differentiation. Preserve the landscape three-character composition, warm ivory blank background, full-body framing, matching scale and large readable faces. Keep the same three synthetic journeys left to right: coastal relaxation, mountain camping, city art-museum outing. Change only the character-design treatment needed to make each an entirely different creature, not a skin or clothing variant.
Remove all carried/attached emblem props, shell pendant, paint palette, painted wing decorations, leaf costumes and clothing-like color borders. The travel meaning must be built into the silhouette, body structure and fur shapes.
Left: a very low, wide, huggable original sea-sprite with a long curled plush tail and broad floppy wave-shaped anatomical ears, four tiny tucked feet, seafoam mint with warm-cream face and tummy, cheeky curious expression. Its body should read as a horizontal wave-soft creature.
Center: a clearly upright pear-bell-shaped original forest-sprite with two broad asymmetrical leaf-shaped FUR ears growing from its head (anatomy, not leaves worn as a hat), tiny root-like plush feet, moss-tipped oatmeal fur, half-closed contented eyes and tiny pleased smile. No leaf cloak.
Right: a small wide diamond-shaped manta-moth-like original dream sprite, with rounded plush side fins that are continuous with its body, two gracefully bent antennae, blush-apricot fur with restrained dusty-lilac tips, an eager but gentle face. Its broad star-like silhouette should differ unmistakably from the horizontal sea creature and tall pear creature. No painter props or clothes.
All three belong to one cohesive 2.5D softly illustrated short-fiber plush world. Do not make the faces identical; use different eye openness, cheek shapes, mouth shapes and temperament while keeping the world's face grammar. High-end collectible charm, compact simplified bodies, warmth, innocent personality, desire to hold and keep them. Clear quiet facial reading at small size; beautiful sculptural volume, controlled fibers rather than fuzzy visual noise. At least one meaningful anatomical signature per creature; do not add unnecessary details. No text, logo, UI, borders or watermark. Entirely original characters, no franchise resemblance. This is a polished art-direction prototype, not a sprite sheet or app UI.

refinements.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Nunti journey-born collectible 2.5D character art-direction refinement. Input image 1 is the user-selected C direction, use it as the visual-world and emotional-tone reference. Create a refined landscape triptych of three original living translucent keepsake companions for the same synthetic journeys: coastal relaxation on the left, mountain camping at center, urban art-museum visit on the right. Preserve the warm ivory background, gentle studio light, polished illustrated 2.5D volume, lovable opaque cream faces, tender expressions and soft rounded forms. Refine ONLY the coherence of the translucent material and the differentiation of the BODY shapes, so they read as three different beings in the same world. They must feel alive and keepable, not tourist objects with a pasted face. No costume-only variants.
Left: a low, wide, gently curved wave-drop body made of frosted aqua sea-glass resin, broad rounded fin ears fused into the body, tiny tucked feet, a sweeping internal wave ribbon. Face directly on the front body, not a spherical baby inside a container. Curious softly open eyes, a tiny delighted mouth. Its outline is distinctly horizontal and flowing.
Center: a taller tapered pear-bell body made of translucent warm honey and muted jade resin. Its soft asymmetric summit and two small leaf-shaped anatomical ears are integral body forms; inside is a restrained layered contour-line motif like a remembered mountain path. A milky cream upper face, sleepy contented eyes and a gentle closed smile. Replace opaque rocky moss and attached leaf decorations with the same frosted resin family as the others. Sturdy tiny rounded feet. Its outline is distinctly upright and tapered.
Right: a wider, rounded asymmetric lantern-star body in opal peach and twilight lilac resin, one upper lobe slightly longer and two short rounded side lobes that are part of its body. A creamy face on the broad front surface, different eye proportions from the other two, quiet delighted expression. A small softly suspended internal arc of light evokes looking at art, no literal palette or painting accessory. Its outline is distinctly broad and softly angular.
All three have softly diffused internal light, satin edges, restrained pearlescent highlights, and high contrast readable faces. Keep the transparent areas calm and uncluttered. Each has different eye/mouth/cheek proportions and temperament within one face grammar. Full-body front three-quarter view at matching scale, three equal columns, generous margins and subtle contact shadows. Clear simple silhouette at small size. No text, logos, UI, borders, jewelry, clothes, sharp crystals, photorealistic glass caustics, glitter overload or existing franchise resemblance. Static design study only.
